Container.Name: stasharr-tagger-nvidia
Container.Overview: Stasharr Tagger for NVIDIA graphics cards. Looks at frames from your Stasharr scenes and recognises what is happening, so Stasharr can suggest markers; on a graphics card a scene takes seconds instead of minutes.[br][br]Needs the Nvidia-Driver plugin from Community Applications. Leave NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES on "all", or paste one card's GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page. The extra parameter --runtime=nvidia is already set.[br][br]After it starts, open Stasharr → Settings → AI markers and enter http://[your server IP]:2705 as the tagger address. The first start downloads the model (about 1.7 GB) into the Models folder. If it shows "cpu" there, the card was not passed through.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Where the downloaded model is kept, so it is only downloaded once.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: all, or the GPU UUID shown on the Nvidia-Driver plugin page.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: OpenCLIP model. ViT-L-14 is the more accurate one and runs well on a graphics card with 4 GB or more; use ViT-B-32 on smaller cards.

Config.Name: Model weights
Config.Description: Weights for the model. Use laion2b_s34b_b79k with ViT-B-32.

Config.Name: Device
Config.Description: auto uses the graphics card when it is passed through, otherwise the CPU.
